Regarding the operational processes at LuxFunds, the reliance on paper-based expense reporting and approval is a significant bottleneck. This manual workflow creates a backlog of unprocessed claims, delays reimbursements, and causes employee dissatisfaction. Additionally, the manual entry process introduces a higher risk of human error. To improve efficiency, LuxFunds should transition to a digital expense management system to automate data entry, streamline approvals, and reduce errors.
